title: Binding Affinity and Interaction Profiles of Erinacines and Erinacerins with iNOS and NF-kappaB Revealed by Molecular Dynamics Simulations.
authors: Hernandez-Munguia, April Michelle; Reyes-Chaparro, Andres; Fregoso-Aguilar, Tomas Alejandro; Tenorio-Barajas, Aldo Yair; Mendoza-Perez, Jorge Alberto; Aguilar-Garay, Ricardo; Nicolas-Alvarez, Dulce E
one_liner_zh: 该研究用分子对接和MD模拟分析猴头菇化合物与iNOS及NF-kappaB的结合亲和力，虽涉及蛋白-配体互作和MD方法，但对象为小分子-蛋白而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与TF-DNA课题关联较弱。
abstract: Chronic neuroinflammation driven by microglial activation is a pathological hallmark of neurodegenerative diseases, and the NF-kappaB/iNOS signaling axis plays a central role in propagating this damage. NF-kappaB-mediated iNOS transcription generates excessive nitric oxide, causing oxidative neuronal injury. The medicinal mushroom Hericium erinaceus produces cyathane diterpenoid erinacines and isoindolinone erinacerins, both reported to attenuate neuroinflammation; however, the molecular basis of their interactions with iNOS and NF-kappaB remains poorly characterized. We screened 21 erinacerins and 18 erinacines against both targets using validated molecular docking, then subjected top-ranked candidates and negative controls to 100 ns molecular dynamics simulations, MM-PBSA binding free energy calculations (+/-SEM), per-residue energy decomposition, backbone RMSD, and ligand-protein minimum distance analyses, with quercetin as reference. The analysis revealed scaffold-dependent target selectivity: erinacerins exhibited preferential stability with iNOS (erinacerin L: RMSD 0.185 nm), whereas erinacines formed more stable complexes with NF-kappaB (erinacines G and J: RMSD < 0.36 nm). Minimum-distance monitoring confirmed that the elevated ligand RMSD in iNOS predominantly reflected surface relocation rather than dissociation. Erinacine S emerged as the most promising dual-target candidate (DeltaGbind: -24.31 +/- 0.16 and -14.24 +/- 0.11 kcal/mol for iNOS and NF-kappaB, respectively), over twofold stronger than quercetin for iNOS. Negative controls revealed that docking-based ranking was target-dependent in its discriminative capacity, underscoring the need for MD-based refinement. These results identify erinacine S as a priority candidate for experimental validation.
abstract_zh: 由小胶质细胞活化驱动的慢性神经炎症是神经退行性疾病的病理标志，而NF-kappaB/iNOS信号轴在传播这种损伤中发挥核心作用。NF-kappaB介导的iNOS转录产生过量一氧化氮，导致氧化性神经元损伤。药用蘑菇猴头菇（Hericium erinaceus）产生氰烷二萜类erinacines和异吲哚酮类erinacerins，两者均被报道可减轻神经炎症；然而，它们与iNOS和NF-kappaB相互作用的分子基础仍缺乏充分表征。我们使用验证过的分子对接 (molecular docking) 方法，针对这两个靶点筛选了21种erinacerins和18种erinacines，随后对排名靠前的候选物和阴性对照进行了100 ns分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟、MM-PBSA结合自由能计算（±SEM）、逐残基能量分解、骨架RMSD和配体-蛋白质最小距离分析，以槲皮素 (quercetin) 作为参考。分析揭示了支架依赖的靶点选择性：erinacerins与iNOS表现出优先稳定性（erinacerin L：RMSD 0.185 nm），而erinacines与NF-kappaB形成更稳定的复合物（erinacines G和J：RMSD < 0.36 nm）。最小距离监测确认，iNOS中配体RMSD升高主要反映表面重定位而非解离。Erinacine S成为最有前景的双靶点候选物（iNOS和NF-kappaB的DeltaGbind分别为-24.31 ± 0.16和-14.24 ± 0.11 kcal/mol），其对iNOS的结合强度是槲皮素的两倍以上。阴性对照显示，基于对接的排名在判别能力上具有靶点依赖性，凸显了基于MD精化的必要性。这些结果将erinacine S确定为实验验证的优先候选物。
